description: This PHP script handles the downloading of attachments in the TestLink project. It initializes necessary dependencies, processes request parameters, checks attachment access permissions (including API key validation), retrieves attachment content from the repository, applies security measures like XSS filtering for SVG content, and outputs the file with appropriate headers for download.

classes.name: tlAttachmentRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling attachment data in the database.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns arguments for the script, parsing GET parameters.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has rights to access attachments, based on configuration.
